CustomField.label: Aliases
CustomField.description: Semicolon-separated spellings that resolve to this platform, e.g. "MCE;ExactTarget;Marketing Cloud Engagement". Matching is case- and punctuation-insensitive (see GtmMigrationPairs.normalize), so "marketing-cloud engagement" hits the same record. This is the one lever that lets Current_Platform__c / Target_Platform__c stay free text: new spellings are a data edit, never a code change.
